name: How do I accurately price my home when selling FSBO in the South Florida market?

mainEntity.name: How do I accurately price my home when selling FSBO in the South Florida market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurately pricing your home for an FSBO sale in South Florida requires thorough research of comparable recent sales (comps) in your specific area, such as Aventura or Coral Gables. Analyze active listings and expired listings to understand market trends and buyer interest. An independent appraisal can provide an objective valuation. Overpricing can deter buyers, while underpricing means leaving money on the table; this is a critical decision factor for a successful sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accurately price your FSBO home by researching comparable sales, active listings, and getting an independent appraisal, especially in competitive markets like South Florida.
